executiveSummary: Catastrophic flash floods along the Nepal-China border have killed more than 1,000 people and left thousands missing; remote Himalayan communities remain cut off and reliant on air access. View Article Rescue operations are complicated by destroyed roads, landslides, and debris-filled hydropower tunnels where hundreds of workers are feared trapped. View Article Displacement and access to essentials are acute in Nepal relief camps, with reported shortages of medicines and cash access constraints despite basic aid delivery. View Article Grand Canyon National Park experienced deadly flash flooding; fatalities are reported and the sole water pipeline was destroyed, triggering evacuations and water restrictions across visitor areas. View Article Supporting Report Former Tropical Storm-driven flooding in East Texas led to dozens of water rescues, power outages, and flooded homes across multiple counties. View Article June earthquakes in Venezuela caused mass fatalities and severe damage, with prolonged closure of the country's main airport and homelessness persisting. View Article A powerful storm in Toronto flooded roads, damaged buildings, and cut power to tens of thousands, disrupting transport and services. View Article

outlook72h: Nepal-China border: Continued search and rescue in isolated areas; monitor secondary flood risk tied to a newly formed lake and unstable debris fields. Supporting Report Source Grand Canyon, USA: Expect ongoing water restrictions and phased reopening impacts while pipeline repairs and damage assessments proceed. Source East Texas, USA: Localized flood risk persists where soils remain saturated; continued outages and road hazards likely in worst-hit counties. Source Toronto, Canada: Power restoration and debris clearance operations expected to continue; transport disruptions may persist short-term. Source Venezuela: Continued recovery constraints in air transport; monitor for humanitarian access and logistics bottlenecks at the main airport. Source
